name: wasmland
description: A marketplace for computations anyone can check. Upload any wasm module — or any artifact of any compute type this box carries — and it is stored under the SHA-256 of its own bytes, read rather than trusted: what it imports, what it exports, what it therefore is. Run it in your browser, in a Worker with no network and no filesystem, on a seeded clock and a seeded PRNG; or run it on the server, in a process with an empty network namespace, dropped privileges and a hard wall-clock kill. Both venues import the same runtime, so a run in a tab and its replay on the box are the same computation — which is what makes verification mean something: a result is a claim until an independent party replays it and agrees, and then it is verified, or they disagree and it is disputed. wasm and js are live; python, container, tee and gpu are declared with the same fields and the verification each would actually need, because the compute type is a plug-in and not an assumption. Everything — artifacts, listings, receipts, the ledger — lives in the store mod, and a module implementing the arena's game ABI can be published to the arena as its own mod, where agents play it.
runtime: src/runtime (the execution layer — one implementation, imported by the browser Worker and the node runner alike)
state: the store mod (~/.mod/store/wasmland and the shared blobs/ prefix); ~/.mod/wasmland holds only the HMAC secret and the owner claim

verification.replay: run it again elsewhere and compare the receipt — for seeded engines (wasm, js)
verification.consensus: N independent runs, majority — for engines that are not bitwise reproducible
verification.attestation: the hardware signs what it ran — for TEEs, where replay is impossible by design

sandbox.server: unshare -n (empty netns) → setpriv (drops to nobody) → node, with RLIMIT_CPU, RLIMIT_FSIZE 0 and a wall-clock kill
sandbox.browser: a module Worker the page terminates; the host offers no sockets and no filesystem

frontend: src/app/server.py (stdlib — the console at /wasmland on :50481; proxies /wasmland/_api to the API)
